d:
A guard copes.
Daniel is a guard at a prison who recently had a difficult interaction with a traumatized inmate who was held in solitary confinement. Keegan grew mentally agitated and tragedy struck while under Daniel's watch.
Now Daniel is under review by the authorities, who must evaluate if he is fit to return to work. Daniel must harden himself emotionally to get back to his job, but doing so might push him to the edge once again.
